errors.text_span: Die Darstellung zeigt, dass die Werte für alle Indikatoren in den 2020er Jahren im Vergleich zu den vorherigen Jahrzehnten abgenommen haben
errors.evidence: This statement overgeneralizes the trends. While it is true that the values for all indicators in the 2020s are lower than in the previous two decades, the phrasing suggests a continuous decrease over time for all indicators. This is not the case for 'Industrieproduktion Deutschland', which increased from 1.0% in the 2000s to 2.2% in the 2010s before decreasing.
